name: Stormy
long_description: Stormy runs the office so your crew can run the work. Every call answered, day or night. Every quote followed up until it is a yes or a no. Jobs booked, crews scheduled, parts tracked, invoices sent and collected. Marketing that brings the work in, and an AI agent for every person on your team — all working from the same job record. Built for the shops that keep physical things running: forklift and heavy equipment service, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, roofing, logistics and yards.
one_liner: Stormy runs the office so your crew can run the work.
